title: How Love And Tragedy Created Demon Akaza

cuts.voiceover_text: Branded with three criminal tattoos, a desperate boy steals medicine repeatedly to keep his sick father alive. Young Hakuji endures brutal public floggings from the magistrate without shedding a single tear. But his painful sacrifice turns into devastating heartbreak when he returns home. His frail father hanged himself from the ceiling to stop his beloved son from living as a criminal. Hakuji clutches his father suicide note in sheer disbelief. He is shattered by profound grief and burning rage. The world punished him for trying to survive, and now the only person he loved is gone forever.

Exiled and furiously brawling with street thugs in a new town, Hakuji is suddenly confronted by an eccentric martial artist named Keizo. Hakuji attacks with pure venom, but Keizo effortlessly dodges every vicious blow and sweeps him straight onto the dirt. Instead of turning the delinquent over to the law, Keizo invites him home to his humble Soryu dojo. Hakuji is completely stunned by this unexpected kindness. For the very first time in his difficult life, someone sees worth in him and offers him a second chance.

Living at the dojo, Hakuji tirelessly cares for Keizo bedridden daughter, Koyuki, nursing her day and night through severe illness. One magical summer evening, he carries her on his back to watch the village fireworks erupt across the sky. Koyuki weeps with overwhelming gratitude as Hakuji passionately vows to protect her with his life. Keizo proudly names Hakuji his dojo successor and offers Koyuki hand in marriage. Hakuji is filled with pure joy. His wounded heart finally finds peace.

While Hakuji visits his father grave to share the happy news, cowardly rivals from the neighboring kenjutsu dojo secretly poison the well, killing Keizo and Koyuki in agony. Hakuji rushes back only to find their lifeless bodies. His sanity shatters completely. In blind grief, Hakuji storms the rival dojo unarmed, smashing heads and tearing through sixty-seven swordsmen in a horrifying bloodbath. He is consumed entirely by monstrous vengeance. Every shred of human mercy has vanished from his soul.

Covered in blood among the sixty-seven corpses, Hakuji is approached by the demon king, Muzan Kibutsuji. Hearing rumors of an unarmed demon, Muzan thrusts his hand deep into Hakuji skull and injects potent demon blood. Hakuji shrieks in agony as all precious memories of his loved ones are cruelly erased. He is transformed into Upper Rank Three demon, Akaza. Stripped of his humanity, only an endless hunger for strength remains.

Centuries later inside the shifting Infinity Castle, a desperate clash with Tanjiro finally breaks through Akaza mental haze. The long-lost memories of his father, master Keizo, and cherished bride Koyuki come flooding back into his conscious mind. Hakuji suddenly realizes the awful truth behind his endless centuries of hatred. The weak coward he despised all along was not his human opponents, but himself, because he failed to save the people he swore to protect. Overwhelmed by deep shame and self-disgust, he stops his deadly attack and refuses to fight.

Even as his headless demon body attempts to regenerate and continue slaughtering, the glowing spirit of Koyuki suddenly appears and tenderly embraces him from behind. She weeps softly against his chest, telling him that he has fought hard enough and can finally rest. Hakuji breaks down in tears of profound relief and sorrow, letting go of centuries of bitter hatred. He turns his own destructive martial arts inward, unleashing a catastrophic strike to obliterate his demonic flesh. Embracing Koyuki tightly in the afterlife, Hakuji is finally forgiven, finding eternal peace with the woman he loves.
